REFERENCE ATLAS

What the reconstruction establishes

Dimensions, not tolerances

Basic EM ACE600: 300 W × 540 D × 640 H mm; chamber 200 W × 150 D × 195 H mm. Flat carrier Ø104 mm, up to 24 Ø12.7 mm holders plus a reserved centre. Dimensions are nominal; accessory surfaces, layout and actuator limits are not independently measured. Leica data sheet 10/20, pp. 3–4.

Scope of the experiment

Fit uses the rectangular tile diagonal against the stub footprint. The solver rotates tile corners, clips the polygon against x ≥ 0, then sums cross-products of adjacent vertices to find its area. At 0°, 6 × 8 = 48 mm²; at 180°, 2 × 8 = 16 mm²; mask off: 64 mm². These are geometric checks, not measured coating data. No deposition, vacuum system or material processing is simulated.
